# VANCOMYCIN

# FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS

Vancomycin 30 mg/kg PD loading dose followed by 15 mg/kg PD every 3 to 7 days in 2000 mL 2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution.
